rows.grounds: compound denoting the measure or extent of the boundary thread
refers to the thread mentioned as the measure
qualifies the thread as valid or authoritative
qualifies the authoritative standard as highest

items.question: What constitutes the supreme authoritative standard for measuring the boundary thread?
premises: The boundary thread has a specific measure.
That same thread functions as the standard of measurement.
This thread is declared authoritative and supreme.
items.inference: Therefore, the boundary thread itself serves as the supreme authoritative standard for its own measure.
uncertainties: The precise ritual or technical application of paryantasūtra in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: The measure of the boundary thread is that very thread, which is the supreme authoritative standard.
